incident-bot: [ALERT] euw2 monitoring: DNS probe cluster 'euw2-net-probes' showing spike and missing telemetry (error rate > 15%). Paging #eng-oncall.
Sam Lee: oncall here — taking first touch. any customer-facing outages reported?
Raj Patel: I see the alert stream, but the probe collector logs are sparse. seems like metric ingestion for euw2 probe shard is delayed/absent. not sure if probes are failing or aggregator losing messages.
Maria Gomez: adding context — we had a suppressor rule triggered earlier that should have grouped alerts, but pager spam still went out. possible suppression-race + missing-metrics combo.
Sam Lee: ok. first step: check probe agent health on euw2 nodes and ingestion queue depth.
infra-bot: probe-agent/euw2-* status: many agents show last-heartbeat ~18m ago. kafka-ingest-euw2 lag: 0 -> 0 (no data). collector-pods (svc/metrics-collector-euw2) show 1/3 ready.
Raj Patel: collector pods failing readiness. logs indicate repeated 429/ECONNRESET from telemetry-ingest endpoint. suspect network egress throttling or intermediate proxy.
Sam Lee: I'm SSHing into collector-01 now.
Sam Lee: collector-01 logs: "Connection reset by peer" and repeated TLS handshake timeouts. Also see frequent "rate limit exceeded" from internal mesh.
Maria Gomez: can we scale collectors as stop-gap? `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/metrics-collector-euw2 --replicas=5` — but if egress is throttled, scaling may make it worse.
Sam Lee: agree. I'll restart the mesh-proxy on a single node to force reconnection and clear stuck sockets.
Sam Lee: run: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/mesh-proxy-euw2-node``` — rolling restart in progress.
infra-bot: mesh-proxy rollout started (3 nodes).
Sam Lee: mesh-proxy restart helped one collector (collector-02) reconnect. we're seeing heartbeat come back from ~20% of probes.
Raj Patel: opened cloud-support ticket with provider — possible AZ-level egress policing. Ticket ID: CSP-489302. pinging vendor contact.
cloud-support: logged: CSP-489302. vendor acknowledges partial internal network degradation in euw2 AZ-B. Investigating.
Maria Gomez: mitigation path A: enable regional fallback routing so probes can send to euw3 collector; path B: temporarily mute noisy pages and mark monitoring as degraded while we restore ingestion.
Sam Lee: doing A for immediate relief. updating probe config to use failover collector: ```curl -X POST https://opsapi/internal/probes/euw2/failover -d '{"collector":"metrics-collector-euw3","ttl":3600}'``` applying now.
Sam Lee: failover applied. infra-bot: 95% of probes re-registered to euw3 collectors within 90s. alert noise dropping.
Raj Patel: good. now need to ensure we don't mask genuine customer impact. any API errors reported from customers in euw2 region?
Maria Gomez: customer ops reporting minor latency blips for a small subset of EU customers around 23:10-23:25 UTC. nothing sustained; no 5xx spikes in public API graphs.
Sam Lee: classification: internal monitoring ingestion outage + alerting noise. customer-facing impact: transient latencies for <0.05% requests. we'll treat as SEV-2 (pager storm + partial telemetry loss).
oncall-sre: Handoff: Sam -> Maria for follow-up. I'm taking oncall for next window, will monitor ticket CSP-489302 and collector health. Maria, assume ownership for postmortem and follow-ups.
Maria Gomez: taking handoff. action items: 1) collect collector logs and upload to S3 2) correlate mesh-proxy throttles and cloud egress logs 3) write incident timeline and RCA draft. I'll coordinate next steps with cloud-support.
Sam Lee: notes added to the thread. immediate mitigation: probe failover to euw3, mesh-proxy restarts, temporary alert-suppression tweak to avoid duplicate paging. alerting state set to "degraded" in console.
Raj Patel: temporary suppressor change: lowered grouping window from 10m -> 2m to reduce duplicate suppression conflict. revert planned after stability for 6 hours.
cloud-support: vendor update: partial network control-plane packet drops in euw2 AZ-B due to control-plane maintenance misconfiguration. no hardware failure. vendor rolling config fix. ETA 45m.
Maria Gomez: Customer comms? Nothing to push externally right now — impact minimal and self-contained. I'll prepare a short note for ops channel if vendor ETA slips beyond 1h.
Sam Lee: thanks all. leaving logs/commands snippet for postmortem:
```
# restart mesh proxy on node
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/mesh-proxy-euw2-node
# scale collectors (cautious)
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/metrics-collector-euw2 --replicas=5
# apply probe failover
curl -X POST https://opsapi/internal/probes/euw2/failover -d '{"collector":"metrics-collector-euw3","ttl":3600}'
```
oncall-sre: monitoring update: collectors stable and heartbeats normal for 4m. paging rate dropped to normal.
Maria Gomez: logging handoff summary into tickets: CSP-489302 + INC-20260318-euw2-probe-telemetry. Postmortem owner: Maria Gomez.
Sam Lee: thanks team. will follow up in postmortem with timing diagrams. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident tagged: SEV-2, postmortem_required: yes, owner: Maria Gomez.
